build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:sidecar && npm run dev

security.csp: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset: codepapr-app:; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' codepapr-app:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost https: data:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:1420 ws://localhost:1420 https:; frame-src 'self' codepapr-app: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: CodePapr - DeepSeek Cache-Optimized Local AI Coding Agent
bundle.longDescription: CodePapr is a local-first coding agent runtime with CLI automation, built on Tauri 2. It features DeepSeek prefix cache optimization, multi-agent collaboration, ProjectGraph semantic analysis, LSP support for 15+ languages, and TodoList task planning -- all running natively on your machine.
